summary: 22-year-old Denver man fell approximately 15 feet below the Adams Falls viewing area, suffering numerous serious injuries; bystanders assisted and notified rangers at 5:45 p.m.; wheeled-litter evac to East Inlet Trailhead by 8:20 p.m., then flown by Northern Colorado Med Evac to Denver Medical Health Center
location: Adams Falls, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Grand County Search and Rescue; Grand County Sheriff's Department; Grand Lake Fire; Grand County Mountain Medic Response Team
